message.content:
The garment is a women's blouse made from knit and woven fabric. The woven front fabric (85% modal, 15% nylon) gives the garment its essential character, so classification follows that fabric.

Because modal is a man-made fiber, the garment goes in heading 6206, women's blouses of man-made fibers. The pullover blouse is woven and does not fall under the knit heading 6106.

Heading 6206.40 covers blouses of man-made fibers. The 10-digit code is 6206.40.3000, which is "Other, women's," not 6206.40.0000 as a generic code. The statistical suffixes under 6206.40.30 are 6206.40.3010 for women's and 6206.40.3020 for girls'. HTS 6206.40.30 is "Other" under 6206.40, and it is divided into 10 (Women's) and 20 (Girls'). The code that applies here is therefore 6206.40.3010.
